areas.name: American Samoa
areas.sentence: Belongs to the United States of America.

areas.name: Antarctica
areas.sentence: No country owns it. A treaty sets it aside for peace and science.

areas.name: Bajo Nuevo Bank
areas.sentence: A small reef in the Caribbean Sea, run by Colombia. The United States also claims it.

belongs.name: Colombia
belongs.why: Colombia runs it. The United States also claims it.

areas.name: Brazilian Island
areas.sentence: A small river island where Brazil, Uruguay and Argentina meet. Brazil governs it; Uruguay also claims it.

belongs.name: Brazil
belongs.why: Brazil governs it. Uruguay also claims it.

areas.name: Bir Tawil
areas.sentence: Land between Egypt and Sudan that neither country claims: each claims a different piece of land next to it instead.

areas.name: United Nations Buffer Zone in Cyprus
areas.sentence: A strip between the north and the south of Cyprus, patrolled by United Nations peacekeepers since 1974.

belongs.name: Cyprus
belongs.why: Cyprus counts it as part of Cyprus. UN peacekeepers patrol it.

areas.name: Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus
areas.sentence: Has its own government in the north of Cyprus. Only Turkey recognises it. Cyprus and the UN treat the whole island as one country.

areas.name: Falkland Islands
areas.sentence: Governed by the United Kingdom. Argentina also claims the islands, which it calls the Islas Malvinas.

belongs.name: United Kingdom
belongs.why: The United Kingdom governs it. Argentina also claims it.

areas.name: Gibraltar
areas.sentence: Governed by the United Kingdom. Spain also claims it.

belongs.name: United Kingdom
belongs.why: The United Kingdom governs it. Spain also claims it.

areas.name: Guam
areas.sentence: Belongs to the United States of America.

areas.name: British Indian Ocean Territory
areas.sentence: Governed by the United Kingdom. Mauritius claims these islands, and in 2025 the two countries signed a treaty to hand them to Mauritius, with the UK keeping a military base on Diego Garcia.

belongs.name: United Kingdom
belongs.why: The United Kingdom governs it. Mauritius claims it.

areas.name: Baikonur
areas.sentence: Kazakhstan rents this land to Russia, which runs a space launch site here.

areas.name: Siachen Glacier
areas.sentence: A high mountain glacier. India controls it; Pakistan also claims it. Their armies have faced each other here since 1984.

belongs.name: India
belongs.why: India controls it. Pakistan also claims it.

areas.name: Kosovo
areas.sentence: Has its own government and declared independence from Serbia in 2008. Serbia does not accept this. Some countries recognise it and some do not.

areas.name: Northern Mariana Islands
areas.sentence: Belongs to the United States of America.

areas.name: Spratly Islands
areas.sentence: Small reefs and islands in the South China Sea. China, Taiwan, Vietnam, Malaysia, the Philippines and Brunei claim some or all of them, and several hold some.

areas.name: Puerto Rico
areas.sentence: Belongs to the United States of America.

areas.name: Western Sahara
areas.sentence: Morocco governs most of it and the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic the rest. Both claim it all. The UN lists it as a territory whose future is not settled.

areas.name: Scarborough Shoal
areas.sentence: A reef in the South China Sea. China, the Philippines and Taiwan all claim it; China has kept ships there since 2012.

areas.name: Serranilla Bank
areas.sentence: A small reef in the Caribbean Sea, run by Colombia. The United States also claims it.

belongs.name: Colombia
belongs.why: Colombia runs it. The United States also claims it.

areas.name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Somaliland
areas.sentence: Has run its own government since 1991. Somalia claims it as part of Somalia. The UN does not list it as a country.

areas.name: Southern Patagonian Ice Field
areas.sentence: A great ice field on the border of Chile and Argentina. In 1998 they agreed how to divide most of it, but part of the line is still not drawn.

areas.name: Taiwan
areas.sentence: Has its own government. China claims it as part of China. The UN and most countries do not recognise it as a separate country.

areas.name: United States Minor Outlying Islands
areas.sentence: Belongs to the United States of America.

areas.name: Guantanamo Bay Naval Base
areas.sentence: Cuba rents this land to the United States, which runs a naval base here. Cuba says the lease is not valid and wants it back.

belongs.name: Cuba
belongs.why: Cuba rents it to the United States, and wants it back.

areas.name: United States Virgin Islands
areas.sentence: Belongs to the United States of America.
